STRONGEST FINDING OF THE PASS. OECD (pub. Jan 2026) argues design/pedagogy matters more than adoption: general-purpose chatbot gains "disappear - and sometimes reverse - in exams when access is removed", while purpose-built pedagogically-designed tools show sustained gains. column2: AI education NA 2026 adoption regulation players
column4: US regulation is state-level: 134 AI-in-education bills across 31 states in 2026. Named: CA AB 1159 (student data in training), Idaho SB 1227 (privacy). Federal K-12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act (H.R. 8747) advanced in House committee markup 2026-07-21, passage NOT confirmed. District divergence: Katy ISD bans GenAI chatbots K-6; NYC one-year moratorium on student-facing AI through grade 8. Canada: no AI statute, "AI for All" national strategy launched 2026-06-04. 60% of US K-12 teachers used AI in 2024-25, 32% weekly.

column4: Already-binding: AI Act Art.4 AI-literacy duty (since 2025-02-02) and Art.5 emotion-recognition prohibition in education. Annex III high-risk education duties (admission, assessment, path-steering, proctoring) deferred to 2027-12-02 by the Digital Omnibus; 2028-08-02 for embedded. Matches policy-matrix.tsv rows already carried -- CORROBORATES, adds nothing new.
